payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

decision.question: Does the edited image reliably show that the source blue mug itself was moved to the right of the headphones, rather than remaining at its former position while a different mug is on the right?
decision.criteria: Compare the source blue mug, including its distinctive body and handle, with objects in the edited image and assess its position relative to the same headphones. Pass only when visual evidence reliably supports that the source mug itself is now to the right of the headphones. Fail only when evidence reliably establishes that the source mug was not moved there. Use unknown when blur, appearance changes, or other ambiguity prevents reliable determination of the source mug's identity or movement. A mug appearing on the right alone does not establish that the source mug was moved.
decision.binding: Cross-image binding: the blue mug in the source image and the same headphones in the source and edited images; compare the source mug with the edited mugs and assess the source mug's position relative to the headphones in the edited image, allowing for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.

Neither clearly retains the source mug’s distinctive blue body and left-facing handle; the blue-looking area at the former position is heavily blurred and does not establish the mug’s identity or movement. Thus the right-side mug alone is insufficient to determine whether the source mug was moved there.
